reviews.text: We use Calvert plumbing for backflow testing yearly for a very responsible price! We were admittedly late this year. Since we had already winterized our outdoor sprinkler, it was recommended to call the county & request for rescheduling to synchronize our due dates at the expense of the company. They could’ve gotten $$ out of us now & again in the early summer when it’s due but instead looked up the number for the county office & told me what to say to get the schedule changed. The lady in the county office was so sweet & understanding too! This is top notch customer service & we were already…
reviews.author: Brittany Hart

reviews.text: Outstanding customer service! I called to schedule a backflow inspection. I was scheduled for service the same day and the report/results were filed with the county the same day as well. Jason and the technician were extremely friendly. This was my third year using this company and i will definitely be using them again. Highly recommend their services!!
reviews.author: robin truesdale

reviews.text: Actually, this is my second experience using Calvert Plumbing. On both occasions, it was a positive experience. Jason and Zach are professional and courteous and the work was performed efficiently and to my satisfaction. I will definitely use Calvert Plumbing in the future and will refer family and friends. Great service.
reviews.author: Lisa Bankins

reviews.text: I've been using them since I moved into my town home. Thank God I've only needed maintenance type work at this pint but the gentlemen that service my home are always polite and professional
